T: Fourth of July. Fireworks and a barbie.
D: A ragtag group of humans fights back against invading aliens on the 4th of July.
P: Serve the mains when the President gives his big speech.
S: Thin sliced potatoes fried crisp, tossed in salt and green chilli powder
Potatoes sliced 1.5mm on a mandoline, rinsed and dried, fried at 170C in batches, tossed in salt and a little green chilli powder.
Popcorn in white chocolate with red and blue sprinkles and popping candy
Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate, then scattered with red and blue sprinkles and popping candy before it sets.
he's been ready for them for years

Topside sliced thin and marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, chilli and smoked paprika, slow-dried until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
M: Smoky pork ribs, corn and potato salad
Paprika rubbed ribs baked then glazed, charred corn, Dijon potato salad
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, unwrapped and glazed under a hot grill. Charred corn, potato salad with mustard dressing.
Double smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted brioche

The Fourth of July cookout Captain Hiller never got to, off the grill and stacked high. Divide 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickle for the sauce. Toast 4 buttered brioche buns cut side down. Smash the balls flat on a very hot greased flat plate or pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack two patties on each bun with sauce, lettuce, tomato, red onion and pickles.
W: Sponge slab with cream, blueberry stars and strawberry stripes
Vanilla slab cake covered in whipped cream, blueberries in the top corner for stars, rows of halved strawberries for stripes.
K: Bourbon and fresh lemonade over crushed strawberries and blueberries

Bourbon stirred into fresh lemonade with crushed strawberries and blueberries, poured over ice in mason jars with a lemon wheel and mint. Make lemonade by stirring 150ml fresh lemon juice and 120ml sugar syrup into 500ml cold water. Lightly crush 100g strawberries and 50g blueberries in the bottom of 4 jars. Fill with ice, add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the lemonade. Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.

steps.text: Slice the potatoes very thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry well.
Heat the vegetable oil to 170C and fry in batches until golden and crisp.
Toss with salt and green chilli powder while hot.
Pop the kernels in a covered pot and spread on a lined tray.
Melt the white chocolate and drizzle over, tossing gently.
Scatter with the sprinkles and popping candy before it sets.
Let set, then break into clusters.

dishes.make_ahead: Ribs up to 1 day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Rub the ribs with the brown sugar, paprika and garlic, then wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 150C until the meat is very tender.
Boil the potatoes until tender, cool slightly, and toss with Dijon, oil and vinegar.
Unwrap the ribs, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Char the corn on a grill.

veg.n: Smoky mushroom ribs, corn and potato salad
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms baked up to 1 day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides, rub with the brown sugar, paprika, garlic and 1 tbsp of the olive oil, then wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until tender.
Boil the potatoes until tender, cool slightly, and toss with the Dijon, the rest of the oil and the vinegar.
Unwrap the mushrooms, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Char the corn on a grill.

s.how: Slice 600g potatoes 1.5mm thick on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and a little green chilli powder while hot.

s.note: Popcorn in white chocolate with red and blue sprinkles and popping candy
s.how: Pop 100g kernels and spread on a lined tray. Drizzle over 150g melted white chocolate and toss gently. Scatter with red and blue sprinkles and 2 packets of popping candy before it sets. Break into clusters.

m.n: Smoky pork ribs, corn and potato salad
m.note: Paprika rubbed ribs baked then glazed, charred corn, Dijon potato salad
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika and garlic. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours, then unwrap and glaze under a hot grill. Char 4 corn cobs. Toss 1kg boiled potatoes with Dijon, oil and vinegar.

m.note: Double smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted brioche
m.how: Divide the mince into 8 balls and keep them cold. Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, tomato sauce and a chopped pickle for the burger sauce. Slice the tomato and onion and shred the lettuce. Butter and toast the buns cut side down. Smash the balls flat on a very hot greased flat plate or pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack two patties on each bun with the sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.

w.note: Sponge slab with cream, blueberry stars and strawberry stripes
w.how: Put a slab sponge cake on a board. Whip 600ml cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar and spread over the top. Fill the top left corner with 125g blueberries for stars, and lay rows of halved strawberries, 500g in total, for stripes.

d.note: Bourbon and fresh lemonade over crushed strawberries and blueberries
d.how: Make lemonade by stirring 150ml fresh lemon juice and 120ml sugar syrup into 500ml cold water. Lightly crush 100g strawberries and 50g blueberries in the bottom of 4 jars. Fill with ice, add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the lemonade. Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
